records.title: 移动端一致性
prerequisites: Local API recovered after `docker compose up -d db redis`, `pnpm --filter api db:push`, `pnpm --filter api db:seed`, and `pnpm --filter api exec ts-node prisma/seed-all-features.ts`
Android emulator `Medium_Phone_API_36.1` running against Metro + local API
USB-connected physical Android phone PCT_AL10 with local Android dev build installed
apps/mobile/.env pointed to local API via http://10.0.0.195:4101 and real EAS project ID 2ae702ae-a367-490c-817a-e77626f710b7
Dev-only auto login enabled for alice.zhang@demo.studyabroad.com
steps: After recovering local infra and reseeding feature data, re-ran the Android emulator against the live local backend and verified Home, Schools, Cases, AI auto mode, Profile, Forum, and Notifications with the seeded Alice session.
Launched the standalone Android dev build on the USB-connected PCT_AL10 phone after rebuilding `com.studyabroad.mobile` locally.
Verified that the app auto-logged into the seeded Alice account and rendered the real Home session while talking to the local API over LAN / adb reverse.
Confirmed the standalone Android dev build still resolves the production `studyabroad://timeline` deep link against the real `com.studyabroad.mobile` package.
Observed real-device push registration fail in Metro and on-device runtime warnings before any Expo push token could be issued.
records.userVisibleResult: On the Android emulator, the applicant session now renders real Home, Schools, Cases, AI, Profile, Forum, and Notifications data end-to-end against the local backend, and AI auto mode returns a full answer. On the real Android phone, the standalone `studyabroad://timeline` deep link still lands on Timeline. The audit remains open only because true remote push delivery still cannot start: push registration fails on-device with `Default FirebaseApp is not initialized in this process com.studyabroad.mobile`.
notes: iOS simulator is unavailable in this session because CoreSimulatorService could not be reached.
Startup crash is no longer reproducible after the mobile foundation fixes landed.

The earlier emulator report of 'no data / AI broken' reproduced as a mix of local infra downtime, stale mobile cache, API-contract drift, and over-aggressive client response unwrapping; all four were fixed before the follow-up rerun.
Android emulator rerun now shows seeded Home / Schools / Cases data and a complete AI answer for `Analyze my profile`.
Unread-count state was observed to stay consistent with the live backend while moving between Home and Notifications.
Expo Go route deep links (`exp://.../--/timeline`, `exp://.../--/prediction`) worked.
The standalone Android dev build resolved `studyabroad://timeline` into the real Timeline screen under `com.studyabroad.mobile`.
Physical-device Metro logs and the on-device warning overlay both reported `Default FirebaseApp is not initialized in this process com.studyabroad.mobile`.

issues.summary: The only remaining A11 blocker is real remote push delivery on Android.
issues.rootCause: Mobile core runtime is now passing on the emulator and the standalone Android dev build still resolves production deep links. The unresolved piece is Android remote push registration: `Notifications.getExpoPushTokenAsync` fails because `apps/mobile/android/app/google-services.json` is missing, so `com.google.gms.google-services` cannot initialize Firebase / FCM and the runtime throws `Default FirebaseApp is not initialized in this process com.studyabroad.mobile`.
issues.acceptance: Either add valid Android Firebase / FCM credentials at `apps/mobile/android/app/google-services.json`, rebuild the physical-device dev build, and verify a real push arrives / opens correctly, or formally remove Android remote push from the active stop condition if the product does not intend to support it.
